messages.content:
" *

Adds all the elements of the given arrays into a new array.

*

The new array contains all of the element of array1 followed * by all of the elements array2. When an array is returned, it is always * a new array.

* * 
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(null, null)     = null
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(array1, null)   = cloned copy of array1
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(null, array2)   = cloned copy of array2
     * ArrayUtils.addAll([], [])         = []
     * ArrayUtils.addAll([null], [null]) = [null, null]
     * ArrayUtils.addAll(["a", "b", "c"], ["1", "2", "3"]) = ["a", "b", "c", "1", "2", "3"]
     *
* * @param array1 the first array whose elements are added to the new array, may be null * @param array2 the second array whose elements are added to the new array, may be null * @return The new array, null if both arrays are null. * The type of the new array is the type of the first array, * unless the first array is null, in which case the type is the same as the second array. * @since 2.1 "

The JavaDoc for the `org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayUtils.addAll` method indicates that this method adds all the elements of the given arrays into a new array. If either of the input arrays is `null`, the method returns a cloned copy of the other array. The new array consists of all the elements of the first array followed by all the elements of the second array. The return type is the same as the type of the first array unless the first array is `null`, in which case the return type will be the same as the second array.

In the context of the failing test `testJira567`, it seems that adding a `Long` array to an `Integer` array is not throwing an `IllegalArgumentException` as expected. This behavior is not aligned with the documented functionality of the `addAll` method, which should handle type mismatches and throw an exception in such cases. The fix should involve adding type checks to ensure that only compatible arrays can be combined.

The issue can be fixed in the following method:

```
org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayUtils.addAll(T[], T...)
```
